_comment: Local fallback configuration for /cross-ai-review. The /focus-group skill's config.json wins when both are present (so a /focus-group panel and a cross-AI run always use the same models). This local config exists so /cross-ai-review works standalone if /focus-group isn't installed alongside.
_policy: Mirror the shape of /focus-group/config.json. Update model ids when new ones ship. Sentinels `deep`, `latest`, `default`, `null`, `none` mean 'let the CLI pick its own latest' -- the script passes nothing and the CLI's built-in default is used.
